These '''ruins''' on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kruskan]] were the location of the mountain stronghold in which [[Sith acolyte/Legends|Sith acolytes]] hid a [[Sith holocron (Kruskan)|Sith holocron]] in around [[3000 BBY]]. It was near the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of the planet.
